thread:
ashley-docs: I opened a PR to reconcile SOC2 audit-log examples and retention wording. Need quick review on snippets and one link fix.
devon-eng: thanks — skimmed. two small nits in the JSON example: `actor` vs `actor_id` naming (we standardized on `_id` suffix).
marta-legal: from compliance POV we should avoid showing raw IPs in public snippets. mark them as redacted or pseudonymized. Also would like a short sentence on legal hold overrides.
ashley-docs: got it. plan: normalize to `actor_id`, replace `user_ip` with `"<redacted>"`, and add one-sentence legal hold clause. will add curl + python SDK examples for export with TTL param.
samir-ml: please include a tiny migration note for teams on schema v1->v2: map `actor`->`actor_id`, drop `user_ip`, and note retention TTL default changed from 365->90 in hosted. keeps folks from being surprised.
ashley-docs: drafting the migration blurb now. also found two broken links to the KMS page (old path) — will update to the new FAQ.
deploy-bot: PR 5821 opened by ashley-docs — https://git.example.com/redwood/docs/pulls/5821 :github:
devon-eng: quick suggestion for snippets: show minimal payload + comment about redaction, e.g.
```json
{"event_id":"evt_1234","timestamp":"2026-03-01T12:00:00Z","actor_id":"anon_abc123","action":"fetch","resource_type":"dataset"}
```
ashley-docs: nice, I'll use that. adding inline note: `actor_id` is pseudonymized and cannot be used to identify an individual.
marta-legal: wording suggestion: 'Actor identifiers in examples are pseudonymized; production systems may contain additional identifiers subject to data-handling policies.'
ashley-docs: added. also adding a tiny SDK snippet for `export_audit_log(retention_days=90)` in python and node. keeping them short.
samir-ml: one more: remove the stray paragraph referencing quantization in the audit docs — looks like a copy-paste from a runtime note. left a code comment in the PR.
avision-bot: link-checker: docs/audit/export.md -> 404.
devon-eng: that's the broken link Ashley mentioned. looks like the file moved during previous refactor.
ashley-docs: fixed the path and added a redirect entry. updated PR.
marta-legal: once migration note is added and user_ip removed from samples, I'm good to approve.
ashley-docs: migration note added: 'Teams migrating from audit schema v1 should map legacy fields to v2: `actor`->`actor_id`; drop `user_ip` or store it in a redacted field; set retention policy via API/console. Contact security if you need legal-hold exemptions.'
devon-eng: CI green except one lint: markdown list ordering. small fix pushed.
samir-ml: reviewed SDK snippets — node example missing async await; pushed tiny change.
ashley-docs: all tests passing now. merging in 5m unless objections. :shipit:
devon-eng: :thumbsup:
marta-legal: approved
notes: Thread about PR 5821: SOC2 audit log docs, snippet normalization, removal of PII in samples, migration note for schema v1->v2, link redirects and CI fixes.
